extraction_notes: Gross fiscal deficit and primary deficit percentages were converted from negative values (indicating deficit) to positive magnitudes. Revenue deficit is reported as 0 as the state had a revenue surplus of 1.34% of GSDP. Debt_pct_gsdp and outstanding_debt_crore reflect post-audit figures as stated in the Executive Summary and Table 1.10. The 'raised_this_year' for audit paras refers to the total number of pending misappropriation cases as the number raised specifically this year is not explicitly stated. The 'money_value_of_observations_crore' is a sum of the money value of pending misappropriation cases (4.90 crore), outstanding Utilisation Certificates (3027.52 crore), pending Abstract Contingent bills (195.75 crore), and unutilised Single Nodal Account balances (349.07 crore) as mentioned in the conclusion section (Page 147).
